messages:
maria-partnerships: Heads up — planning a joint GovCloud announcement with ShieldVault for next month. Main integration points are SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, and KMS/HSM BYOK. Can we sync owners and blockers?

ben-security: Sounds good. Priority items: FIPS compliance, HSM attestation, key lifecycle/rotation policy. We should draft a security checklist.

cara-product: From product side we need a marketplace listing for the gov region, docs + SDK examples for BYOK flows, and a short demo script.

arjun-eng: I can provision a dedicated gov staging cluster, but need partner certs and KMS endpoints. Who owns infra tasks?

maria-partnerships: Kevin (SI lead) will run the integration POC with ShieldVault. @kevin-si can you confirm test plan and timeline?

kevin-si: I can take that. SI will build a connector adapter for SCIM and SAML metadata ingestion. POC ETA ~2 weeks assuming we get partner metadata + KMS API details. Need a contact at ShieldVault.

ben-security: Please add threat model + key handling doc to the POC scope. Also need to agree on secret rotation cadence and access controls. Legal sign-off required for BYOK addendum. :warning:

sara-legal: We need an export control check and a partner MSA addendum for BYOK/HSM usage. Send drafts to legal@redwood.com and mark as high priority — we'll triage.

arjun-eng: I'll stand up gov staging once I have SAML metadata and partner certs. Kevin, please DM the ShieldVault ops contact so I can request certs.

kevin-si: DM'd contact. Also proposing a small joint canary for a couple customers post-POC before wide announcement — minimizes blast radius. Thoughts?

cara-product: Agree on canary. Gate public announcement on successful E2E canary + SOC2 evidence for the gov deployment. We should also prepare rollback messaging.

maria-partnerships: Action items: Kevin -> SI POC & partner contact. Arjun -> infra + staging. Ben -> security checklist + threat model. Sara -> legal addendum. Cara -> marketplace listing + demo. Meeting to align Thu 11am PT. @announce-bot can you schedule? :calendar:

announce-bot: Meeting scheduled: Thursday 11:00 AM PT. Invite sent to maria-partnerships, ben-security, cara-product, arjun-eng, kevin-si, sara-legal.

ben-security: One more ask — Redwood Console needs a KMS usage panel (per-customer metrics) and masking by default for any key identifiers. @arjun-eng can you add a placeholder dashboard for the demo?

arjun-eng: Yep — will add a KMS usage panel and a masked key-id view for the staging demo.

maria-partnerships: Great. I'll draft a short press embargo and a partner quote; will share in the thread. Anything else we missed? :thumbsup:

kevin-si: We'll also want an ops runbook for on-call during the canary window. Adding to POC scope.

ben-security: Adding monitoring checklist: audit logs, anomaly alerts on KMS calls, and replay resistance tests.

cara-product: I'll prep the marketplace blurb and the demo checklist today so we can review on Thu.

maria-partnerships: Thanks all — see you Thu.
